Tara (Eng-API): quick pulse: planning proto-first for new internal APIs. main worry: gateway JSON transpile may hide per-method telemetry. anyone seen this bite us?
Mikko (Platform): yes, gateway sometimes collapses RPCs into one endpoint. we lost per-method p95 during a canary.
Hannah (Eng-Platform): we prototyped a compact telemetry header: base64 proto with version, service, method, sample_id. backend libs decode and emit method metrics. works well.
Diego (DevEx): console needs an "Edge vs Backend" toggle and indicator for services that don't emit the header yet. PMs were confused during the last rollout.
Samir (SRE): ops note: keep header <1KB, prefer 8-byte sample_id. watch parsing CPU under high QPS.
deploy-bot: canary gateway build with telemetry-envelope enabled to prod-eu at 2025-05-02T11:03:00Z :rocket:
Tara (Eng-API): action items: Tara/Hannah draft proto + base64 header spec; Samir gives perf limits; Mikko drafts migration plan. Sync tomorrow 9am PT.
